title: Colored natural, kinky hair
text:
I have bleached and colored natural, kinky hair. This is the first time I've ever colored my hair and I made sure to do my research on colored hair care, which includes protein treatments. Well, months had gone by and I still hadn't done a protein treatment. Madness, right? Eventually, the dyed parts (especially the ends) started to feel rough and dry.The ends were also knotting like crazy! I remembered a YouTube video I watched about hydrolyzed wheat protein. I ordered that and a pair of hair shears (prepared to do some clipping, which I had also been neglecting). I heard that you should expect to see results after the first use, but I was blown away! First, I cleansed my hair with shampoo. I didn't measure how much of the treatment I used but I mixed it in with my regular, wash out conditioner. After coating my hair in it, I covered my hair with a plastic cap then sat with my conditioning heat cap on my head for about 15 minutes.
My hair in general, not only the dyed area, feels softer and the colored ends feel smooth and manageable again. Also, waaaaay less knotting. After washing my hair, I put it in twists to dry. 2 days later I pulled out the twists to get a lovely, voluminous twist-out. Unfortunately, I didn't get the shears but Amazon promptly refunded me and I plan to reorder them shortly. I'm ashamed to say its been months since my ends have been clipped (which just compounded the problem) and I plan to use my protein treatment around once a month and trim when needed.

title: Apply it outdoors
text:
I bought some of this in the Caribbean last week for my toes. I was tempted to buy 3 and get 1 free but am glad I didn't now. I bought a lighter color that turns a darker sparkly pink outdoors. If you apply it indoors you can’t tell if it’s going on neatly.

The Good: It does change color in the sun - the colors are nice
The Bad: It doesn't go on evenly. It tends to streak and is difficult to apply. I didn't find it to be quick-drying.

I applied it indoors then went outside and could see how it had gone out of the nail line all over my toes and I had to use a Q-tip w/nail polish remover to clean up around the nail. It wasn't easy to do that and not remove polish that was already on there, even when waiting a few minutes for it to dry. I applied a couple more coats but still had to clean up.

The final look is ok but doesn't look like a professional pedicure that's for sure. I'm not sure my nail-tech would appreciate having to apply this. Perhaps if I had purchased one without glitter it would have been easier to apply. I think the concept is great, and glad I tried it but also glad I didn't buy for gifts.

The 3-star average rating this has been getting is fair.

title: Tightening and moisturizing serum
text:
This is such a great anti-aging serum that provides moisturizing and tightening effect to my face in the short time since I have followed the instructions and included the serum in my twice a day skincare routine. Hyaluronic Acid helps the skin hold in more moisture; Vitamin C helps brighten and even skin tone. Together, they work magic and indeed are the best ingredients to fight signs of aging. This product leaves the skin feeling silky soft and really helps with diminishing the appearance of fine lines. The serum has worked well with my other facial products and there is no conflicts in over application of ingredients or mixture of fragrances. My skin does not look quite as tired as before and it has continued to look better.

I love the pump dispenser because it is more sterile than taking it out of a jar or regular container. Aside from the convenience of its portability, after reading all of the benefits, I have been adding it to my daily routine and using it prior to my regular moisturizer. The great thing is that because it is so hydrating that I seem to use less of my regular moisturizer. The texture of this product is a clean feeling and lightweight gel. It goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and does not leave a greasy feel. The serum has no scent or artificial chemical fragrance which I prefer and a little of the product goes a long way. It takes two small squirts onto my finger to get a thin layer covering my face. Once it dries, it leaves my skin feeling absolutely refreshing. It is quite moisturizing as well, so it locks in all the water in my skin and gives it a supple feel all night long.

The serum takes a minute to dry and then I apply my makeup. My foundation goes on very smoothly over it and it seems like I have been applying much less makeup lately. It helps keep my makeup looking smooth and moist longer. I find it work better as a makeup prime than many premium brand makeup primers I have tried. My facial lines around my nose has even seemed less pronounced under my makeup. In just two weeks I have been using the serum, I have noticed that my skin tone has become more luminous and healthier looking. I have not seen any fading of sun spots that I have, but I am hopeful with long term use that they will eventually lighten up. Based on what my experience has been so far, I am confident that with consistency and patience, I will see more progress down the road. This is a wonderful wrinkle smoothing serum and I highly recommend it.

Disclosure: I purchased the serum at a discount for my honest and unbiased review.

title: PURE GOLD! MAGICAL! CANNOT LIVE WITHOUT THIS NOW!!!
text:
This stuff is magic! I have really dry, peely lips and I never wear lipstick/gloss/etc. because it always ends up looking bad. Despite my hardcore chapstick obsession (I have a drawer full of various chapsticks in my desk) I thought maybe some higher-end lip moisturizer might do the trick for me. I invested in a good lip scrub and purchased the Nuxe Rev de Miel and the Bite Beauty agave lip mask after hearing rave reviews on both (as an aside: I think the "big gun" ingredient in the agave lip mask is lanolin, which should be fairly easy to find, but for some reason I can never track down lanolin products to use on my lips). While both were nice, neither rocked my world, and so my hunt began again. I happened to stumble across [...] and her review of the laneige lip mask, which I have been curious about but have yet to bite the bullet on the $20+ price tag, and this pure smile snail lip treatment. After reading her RAVE review, I was desperate to get my hands on some, although it was a little hard to track down, but I found it for a good price here on Amazon and decided to go for it (plus free shipping, who can argue with that?!). Boy am I glad I did! This stuff is AMAZING! First, I've never really had any lip products quite like this before. There is a fruity scent underscored by a minty scent and flavor, both of which are mild and pleasant. The texture is very thick and sticky, far more than anything I have ever used before, but it doesn't bother me as I put it on then go to bed. If you rub it into your lips vigorously it will be "pushed" out to the edges of your lips and sort of gather in the corners and along the edges of your mouth, and sometimes if I do this I have to spread it around again to make sure it's really coating my lips. It feels like a protective film, and once it has absorbed in (takes awhile since it is so thick and sticky) your lips are UNBELIEVABLY soft. Like nothing I've ever experienced before! I love this stuff! I hope they never stop making it or I might be completely heartbroken.

Just one observation, I did develop a blemish on my lip line of my bottom lip a few days after I started using this, but I'm not sure if it is related. That does happen to me on occasion, and it could just be a coincidence, but worth mentioning.

title: Easy & Painless, Temporary Smoothing w/ Serum-Enjoy It But Can’t Gauge Long Term Benefit
text:
﻿I’ve been using the NIRA Skincare Laser & Hyaluronic Acid Serum for a couple weeks and can’t yet gauge whether the laser is effective at increasing collagen production and smoothing wrinkles as a long term benefit. I get good results from the hyaluronic acid (HA) serum as it gives quick but temporary plumping and smoothing of wrinkles, as do other good HA serums. I also suspect the warmth created by Nira laser may increase absorption of the HA serum and boost its short term benefits (though I can’t say for sure).

I assume it will take regular use for at least 60 days (and likely 90 days) to judge Nira‘s benefits beyond the temporary HA plumping. Nira’s own before and after photos are from the 90-day mark. While I’ll continue use of the Nira laser to see if it helps, I question the extent of any long term benefits based on Nira’s own photos that show a smiling before photo and a rather solemn after photo; clearly, we more lines are evident when smiling so I feel photos would be more credible if they showed someone with the same or similar expression in the before and after photos.

Still, I like the Nira laser as it holds a charge well and is quick and easy to use. It gives feedback via beeps. Nira states it has FDA clearance (which I haven’t verified) for wrinkle treatment around the eyes. I’m cautious about the eye area, so I’m initially trying Nira on less sensitive skin between my eyebrows where I have fine lines and slight sagging and also on my neck where I have a weird wrinkle likely from looking down at my tablet. I started using Nira on fine lines around my mouth, but I may hold off until I feel confident it won’t exacerbate existing pigmentation issues.

Nira is painless and I only feel warming on setting 2 or 3 (depending on area). The skin around my mouth is drier and only tolerates a 2, and it turns red temporarily. I’ve tried a 4 between the eyebrows and it stings, so I’ll need to work up. I use the HA serum after use, and it’s a clear gel like serum that’s calming and my redness goes away quickly. I get a quick plumping effect that temporarily helps smooths lines, but I can’t say if Nira will provide a long term benefit over time. I do like using it with the serum, so I’m rating it 4 stars. I’ll update as appropriate.

title: Best value in $/oz for a true believer
text:
I bought this giant pack after trying the 16oz tea tree oil cleansing conditioner and did some crazy calculation on the total/average cost of different ways of purchasing this really expensive hair cleansing product from multiple sources.

Obviously, you can tell I'm quite convinced by this product, or else I wouldn't invest so much work/resources into getting it. Because these things take a while to use, I will be updating my review as I finish each flavor included in this set. I will not be using the Sweet Almond Mint, which is too oily for me and I'm sure you can find plenty of review on other package sizes.

* Overall Impression *

1. Great reduction in hair loss
2. Great increase in manageability
3. Quite expensive for regular use

A lot of people say "this product changed my life!" I don't want to exaggerate my excitement. I think to be very fair this product made me discover something I never experienced with other commercial shampoos - "near zero hair loss after wash".

I was a heavy shedder and I was used to losing a lot of hair everyday. With this product, I hardly lose any piece of hair at all during the day, with everything else being the same as my old-shampoo days. I have to say I don't know how it will compare to shampoo during hair wash with an equal comparison (i.e. same washing technique). WEN requires you to comb your hair during washing, which causes hair to shed when I wash my hair. I did not comb my hair while I was using shampoos so I didn't know if combing in wash would be the same. All else being the same, I lose about the same amount of hair during washing using shampoo or WEN. The no hair loss during the day is amazing though. I might have been allergic to the commercial shampoos and never knew it. My hair now feels significantly thicker when putting into a pony tail.

Another great discovery is that WEN makes my hair very smooth, light but not necessarily shiny. It dries faster after wash. It also feels easier to manage - my hair now stays in the right shape - this is especially true after the 24 hours. My hair would have started to feel lumpy and oily if I had used shampoo, but WEN keeps my scalp evenly moist a little longer. With these two improvements, I no longer use styling products or a blow dryer.

* Impression on the Flavors I Have Tried *

Tea Tree 5 of 5
Fig 5 of 5
Cucumber Aloe 3 of 5

Very short, I would recommend people with oily/combination skin type stay away from the Cucumber Aloe. Somehow it feels more water-based I had to use more to wash each time. At the same time, even though I make sure to wash it off completely, my scalp/hair started to feel oily sooner than when I use tea tree and fig versions. Both Tea Tree and Fig are great for oily/combination type. They make my hair feel clean and refreshed. Fig makes my hair feels extra smooth and it is the richest/densest of the three.

* How Long Does a 32oz Bottle Last? *

When the WEN TV infomercial says the 12oz starter version is a "30-day" supply, you need to understand that it is for people with very short, thin, or little hair. For someone like me with long, very thick Asian hair going to mid back, the 16oz tea tree bottle survived barely one month with washing at least every other day.

Two other things to keep in mind:
The 32oz pump holds more than a 16oz pump, but less than twice the amount.
Each flavor varies in its moisture strength. As mentioned earlier, I had to use more Cucumber Aloe to achieve the same effect I can do with Tea Tree and Fig.

I made a chart documenting my process of finishing up the 32oz Cucumber Aloe bottle. In total there were about 250 pumps, which lasted me 50 days with 30 washes, average 8 pumps per wash.

* How Much Should You Use For Each Wash? *

I definitely recommend strictly following the WEN instructions when you begin. That is, use the large amount as instructed by WEN, follow the steps to rinse, massage, comb, leave in, rinse off. This will help you see how the proper use can really change your hair as they've claimed. However, this is an expensive product so we all want to use it efficiently. Once you have formed the proper washing habit, start reducing the pump number little by little until you find your optimal dose. I found my optimal to be about 1/2 of the recommended amount for my hair length. Given the amount of hair I have, I'm sure many people can save more once you've started using it.

On average I use:
Tea Tree 16oz - 15 pumps per wash (haven't started the 32oz bottle yet)
Cucumber Aloe 32oz - 8-9 pumps per wash
Fig 32oz - 7 pumps per wash

title: A Thick and Rich Eye Cream.
text:
EDITED REVIEW as of 9/25/21.

I came back to edit this review and to lower my rating from 4 stars to 3 stars. Here's why:

After a few weeks of using this cream, I started to develop some sensitivity to it. When I say sensitivity, here's what I mean: 1) The scent bothered me more than it did when I first used the cream. In fact, I started to sneeze most evening after applying it. 2) I'd used the cream on other areas of my face, and noticed minor breakouts in those areas.

Basically, I think the cream was just too oily for my skin. Even around the eye area, which has virtually no oil glands, the non-absorbency of the cream left me feeling sticky and greasy even though I gave the cream plenty of time to absorb.

End of Edit.

***************************************************************************************************************************

Everything else I said in my original review still stands. But the above edit may help you decide if this is the right eye cream for you.

If you're looking for a natural, plant-based eye cream that is ultra-thick and rich, you'll find it in this 2 oz. jar.

The jar will last a VERY long time, because you only need a tiny amount of this cream to cover the undereye area and the corners where crows feet form.

I'd advise putting the cream on a couple of hours before bed, since it takes quite a while to absorb into the skin. (If you don't wait, you'll end up depositing most of the cream on your pillowcase.)

I've also used a small amount of this cream on other areas of my face (nose to mouth lines) and the results were the same as around my eye area.

So what were the results? The skin around my eye area looked smoother and brighter after one night of use.
The results on other parts of my face were less noticeable, but I believe continued use of the cream will improve the results in both the eye area and on the face.

I'm rating the cream 4 stars instead of 5, because of one major issue I have with it, which is: THE SCENT.
The cream has a rather strong minty (?), menthol (?) medicinal smell that takes some time to fade away.
Since I prefer NO SCENT in eye/facial products, I deducted one star from my rating.

That aside, if scented products don't bother you, and you want a thick, rich eye cream you will probably enjoy using this one.

title: They changed the formula since 2020
text:
The original 2020 formula had great slip, hydrated my kinky hair, while creating AMAZING curls. I could wear the product for two weeks without shampooing, but refreshing the curls and adding more product every other day. It air-dried easily too.

The 2021 version has a different formula with different ingredients. If you have kinky hair it won’t create curls, it doesn’t have good slip anymore and it definitely does not dry easily. HOWEVER, if you’re looking for something to nurture and moisturize your strands, this is the product to use. It’s best used on damp, clean, conditioned hair; you can then add in this product and put your hair into small twists.

Yes, it takes FOREVER (DAYSS) to dry because the main ingredient is marshmallow root which is a very sticky substance when melted BUT once it is dry, you can untwist and the hair is shiny, soft, and swishes side to side on its own.

If you prefer untwisted styles, I suggest putting in the product all over your clean, damp hair, wait a day for it to dry, then add in the gel of your choice while gently detangling.

Either way I notice that while using it I retain more length, experience less breakage, and more scalp health.

Moral of the story: because of the formula changing over the past few years, this product takes a lot work if your texture is more kinky/coily. Biggest suggestion: use if you’re google to use it, commit to it and learn how to make it work. If you’re looking for a quick fix, I don’t recommend this product for you.

I have never used a felt tip brow pen before. For being a 1st time user, I have to say this took me longer to do than a brow pencil & powder. (Approx. 20 mins)

Because I have barely any brows and draw them pretty thick, the areas w/ just pen flicks, turned shiny after a while. I have combo skin, so I always fear my brows will look oily or somehow fade away during the day. But I did appreciated the long wear of this product.

Since I didnt know how to use this pen well, during application, it seemed like it was "drying out". DONT CAP & SHAKE! It made a mess into the cap and all over the tip.

All you need to do is hold the pen at a vertical angle while flicking and gravity will do the rest. I also suggest standing it cap side down in your pencil cup, so it will always be moist.

Im sure with more practice, it will be easier & faster to use. The end result does give a more natural look resembling hair strokes and I was satisfied w/ the color.

title: Interesting design. Very nice rubber brushes.
text:
This comes as a set of 2 brushes. I was intrigued by the design of these detangling brushes. The brushes appear to be constructed of quality materials, with a nice tactile feel (meaning they feel good in the hand). Examination of the brushes found them to be free of defects, both were in excellent condition, thus it had quality manufacture.
There is a spacing bar that separates the brush tines (for lack of a better term). On specific segments, there is a hole in the tine, which correlates to a prong in the spacer bar. This kinda determines the spacing of the segments, with each space on the bar 'snapping' over the brush tine for a secure connection. One of the attached photos shows a close-up of the spacer bar and the brush tines to illustrate the parts and the holes in select tines. Amazingly, it is a working setup.
The rubber bristles are excellent to run through the hair. It is slightly curved, with long bristles. They are firm, but not inflexible. My initial impression is very positive, it's an excellent brush.
Cleaning is simple, too. Just pull out any errant hair strands, and run it under hot water. Done.
Overall, the brushes match up to the descriptions and depictions in the product details. It fully met expectations, too. In fact, I think I like the feel of the brush more than I expected. As such, this set of 2 rubber detangling brushes receive a 4.25 - 4.5 star rating, with a moderately high level recommendation.

title: Once You Learn How To Use, It's Great
text:
I know it says "Men's" on there, but I am a woman, and I use this razor. I just happen to have very coarse hair on my legs. Lady shavers don't do it for me. In fact, I've always had to use 2 razors, a men's for the legs and a women's for the underarms. I know, more information than you wanted, but it's relevant.

This razor is the only one I have ever had that works for everything. Oh, I had some really nasty razor burn before I got the hang of it, but since then, it's been great! No cleaning and maintaining 2 razors any more.

I have found with this razor, that putting pressure on it is a big no-no. If I do that, it will tear up my skin big time. I have to just sort of guide/glide it over the area, no pressure on it, and it does a beautiful job without the razor burn. Now, I honestly don't know how that would go for a guy and his face, but that's how it works for me on ALL parts I shave.

This razor only needs charged about every two to three weeks. There is no indicator system on this razor, and when it needs charged, it just quits. If you keep playing with the on/off button, it will run for 2 or 3 more minutes, but that's it. It takes one hour (about) to recharge, much better than any razor I ever had before.

This razor is easy to clean, just run the head under the sink, shake the water off, and let it dry out. I do that once a week. Easy peasy.

Like I said, I've no idea how my experience might translate for a guy. I gave it 4 stars because of the lack of a recharge indicator. Other that, it is wonderful for me.

title: My Lips Look and Feel Great Thanks to Hudson and James Cloud Lip Balm!
text:
Usually, by this time of the year (late October), my lips are already chapped. Thanks to Hudson and James Cloud Lip Balm my lips are still looking, and feeling, great. I received the balm inside a short, round, 0.5-ounce glass jar. It came tightly sealed inside a form-fitting bubble-wrapped envelope. There was a tiny, round transparent protective seal on the jar and its large black lid. The seal is not very effective. I was able to easily open the cap without realizing the seal was there. The print on the jar is very tiny. After looking at the jar several times with a magnifying glass, I couldn't locate an expiration or a best by date. Many hygiene product don't have them but they should. These dates let me know if the ingredient are still fresh.

I use the Cloud Lip Balm twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening. The balm feels nice on my lips. It is very easy to smooth all over my lips. It reminds me of some expensive high-end lip butter that I once owned. The jar is small enough to fit inside the pockets of my jeans. During the day, I use Carmex Classic Lip Balm when necessary. The Cloud Lip and the Carmex are working together well to protect my lips and to keep them appearing healthy and attractive. I've been faithfully using the Cloud Lip Balm for nearly three weeks and have not experienced any adverse side effects or allergic reactions. It doesn't have a noticeable scent. Also, I would like to note that the balm has a light-yellow waxy color whereas Amazon's website shows it to have a creamy white color.

The Hudson and James Cloud Lip Balm doesn't sting or burn my lips after applying it; I hardly notice that it is there. What I do notice is that my lips are feeling and looking great despite the change in seasons. I wish I knew the price of the lip balm. At the time of this review, it wasn't available for purchase. Overall, I like this hygiene product and would strongly recommend it to anyone who suffers from dry, chapped lips.

title: 6 piercings, quick and painless!
text: 6 piercings for $9! Not bad at all. Easy to use, common sense really. Tip: be sure to remove white square and push the blue thumb tab in just a bit (until you hear a click) to make it easier for when you are ready to pierce the ear. Not necessary, but highly recommend. Also makes it easier to align the earring to your placement marking. I pierced my second lobe holes myself, easy and painless. Next day, my sister asked to me re-pierce her holes and add her second holes. She took all four like a champ, wasn’t too bad, just sore for a few days because the backs of the earrings are kind of uncomfortable (especially when trying to sleep on your side), but bearable. I’d be sure to have the backing of the earring at the farthest end to ensure space for your lobe to breathe and in case there is any swelling. Also be smart about the whole process, use common sense. Wash your hands with antibacterial soap, wear gloves, clean the lobe and surrounding skin with alcohol (it includes some alcohol pads by the way, so no excuse), mark your spot (triple-check if it is even!), and take the disposable out of its sterile packaging, consider my tip above, align with marking, and push blue tab quickly. Voila, your lobe is pierced. After care is just as important, so clean your earrings and freshly pierced lobes with a saline solution!!! I wouldn’t recommend alcohol or hydrogen peroxide as it can be drying and may irritate your pierced lobes and possibly become infected. So yeah, saline solution, or ear cleaning solution. You can buy a bottle at Claire’s or even here on Amazon. Twice a day, every day, for at least 6 weeks straight. Try to avoid makeup in your ear/neck area, but if anything, just remove your makeup at the end of the day and clean your piercing with saline solution. You can occasionally do salt soaks or saline solution soaks. Helps deep clean and heal faster I heard. Anyway, I’d recommend this product if you’re looking to pierce your lobes and don’t want to pay to have it professionally done at a more costly price. If you have the guts to pierce yourself with a hollow piercing needle, i’d do that instead, but because I couldn’t do it myself, I chose to get the disposable ear gun/staple.

text:
Okay. So this product was one I finally said, screw it I'm going to try it, because I have been looking for mirror like polish for almost two years. The mirror wffect is amazing! Especially if you do it right. I posted 4 photos, from start to finish. The real metallic mirror finish definitely looks better before you put on the top coat, but it will rub right off within a few minutes to hours if you don't seal it with a top coat. The first photo is with the bottom coat, second the mirror effect chrome, third the finished product.
Another thing you have to know is your surface needs to be smooth and clean before beginning, just like any work space. Second, once you paint on the chrome don't go over it again, it'll look terrible in the end. So once the chrome mirror polish dries, leave it alone! If it doesn't look the way you wanted, just grab a dry napkin and wipe it off and start again. Trust me it'll look better this way.
Now... For the product quality itself... I would say it is good but not great. I have a better quality gel top coat that I use and like better. I actually used it the second this doing this, and it worked better. But this top coat I used when doing other things to my nails. Not sure why it doesn't perform as it should, perfectly, like my other brand top coat, but it doesn't do ya... It's a good top coat still, so not a total loss there... And yes it does chip if you don't use at least 3 coats of top coat. 3! That's key to a good gel top coat... Layered for strength. I do my own acrylic nails and all my decorating, so I have a good quality gel setting lamp, with 6 bulbs inside, and I use good quality products... It's worth it to spend an extra $2-3.
But overall great product and I'm happy I spent the money! I love my chrome nails!

title: Works on Bites, Burns, Cuts and Stings Really Quick
text: I live in a very hot, dry area of Southern California. We are constantly in the sun because there's actually no way to avoid it. We have been using the Shea Butter for about 2 weeks now. We have used it for insect bites (specifically spiders and mosquitos), mild sunburn, burns from chemicals and of course as a daily moisturizer. The smell is a little stinky, so what we do when we use it as a daily moisturizer is soften it and mix it in with our store bought cocoa butter and shea butter lotion. The store bought lotion really does smell like cocoa so mixing it with the raw shea butter eliminates the shea odor. It actually allows the cocoa butter smell to overpower it. I feel and smell like a nice, soft milk chocolate bar after showering. A friend of mine had to crawl under a house full of mold, mildew, spiders, etc. Although he was fully covered in protective clothing and a gas mask, his arms were swollen, stinging and very painful when he came out. I gave him a chunk of the shea butter to rub all over this arms and hands and he felt instant relief from the stinging and pain. There are many uses for this shea butter and I'm sure most people will discover a use no one else had even thought of yet. Don't be afraid to put it on any part of your skin that needs some relief from pain, no matter what the sourse was. It truly is like real butter, so use it plentifully and use a clean towel to remove any excess after most of it has absorbed into your skin. This is a big chunk of shea butter, but I think it will come in so handy it won't be long before I need to order more. The price, shipping, packaging, etc can't be beat either. I definately give it a 5 star rating.

text: I could not find a forum for which to review Igora's Color Creme hair dye, so this forum will have to do. Then, the instructions tell me that I must mix the color cream with another creme called Oxigenta, which was not included. title: WORTH THEY BUY!
text:
First off and to the bottom line, for quality and price point totally WORTH THE BUY!!

For reference, I ordered the 22 inch Color #2 Darkest Brown. I am 5'11" and ordered a length similar to my own hair.

Now for the background: I am mid 40s and I have always had SUPER thick, curly hair until an autoimmune thing kicked in at which point I lost 3/4s of that volume over a year. So I've been playing around with hair extensions. If we can dye out grays, do our nails, etc. to feel better about ourselves, why not hair extensions?? This particular piece is AMAZING! Honestly, it could be thicker, but then I feel it would be too heavy. It's perfect for me.

The color matches perfectly. The length is accurate. The sheen is beautiful. Some other reviewers complained about it tangling, and although it does, it doesn't tangle more than my own hair and brushes out back to original form with ease. ...Some other reviewers said it doesn't stay in place and I personally disagree. I straighten my hair, put it up in a ponytail at the height I want, clip in the extension, wrap the extra piece and secure with 3-4 bobby pins around the base. That may sound like a lot of work, but really it isn't (especially since I only wash my hair every third day or so, and in between days, I just shower without wetting my hair). It took me a couple tries to perfect it, but since, I have it down and wear it for 12-14 hours continuously without an issue. No headache, no slipping. My hair blends with the extension and you can't tell which strands are "real". ...Admittedly, I haven't played around with curling it or anything so I can't commit or advise on that.

All in all, I feel this is a cheap, quick and easy way to feel beautiful. And everyone deserves to feel beautiful! Hope this review helped :)

title: Good.  However, probably not for oily skin
text:
This foundation has potential IF you use a good primer with it. I have combination skin and, like many foundations, this can settle into pores and creases. Some foundations are better than others in terms of this tendency, and I'd say this one is about "par for the course" with regard to settling in pores and creases. Primer will help.

This does seem to have a lot of moisture in it (as I've found with many foundations that have "satin" in the title). For me, I feel a bit dewy and not quite clean enough in this -- especially when I look in my 10X magnification mirror.

However, I'd venture to guess that people with dry skin might actually appreciate this. Whereas people with oil prone skin and/or visible pores -- will NOT appreciate this so much.

I ordered the Fair color and I'm an NC20 or NC25. The color is great (not orange and not pink). Nice neutral color. It was just slightly lighter than my natural skin color and looked great with a light dusting of bronzer / blush. I always prefer to err lighter than my natural color than to go to darker, and end up looking like and orange pumpkin.

NOTE >>>Be sure to shake this well before each use<<< I noticed if I don't shake this, the first spray is mostly moisture and has a shiny greasy effect. Product applies much better if it is well shaken first. This should be in bold print on the front of the can.

I spray this into a little eyelash tray (or back of hand, or where ever) and dab my make-up brush into it. Then, apply to face.

Its a good foundation. However, getting up into this price point, I felt some of the above minor gripes warranted removing a star.

title: The trays alone are worth buying this kit
text:
In researching teeth whitening products on Amazon, it quickly became clear to me that a custom teeth whitening tray would be the best solution. My teeth are straight enough that my parents and I decided against my getting braces as a child, but they are crooked enough (especially my mostly-hidden bottom teeth) that I worried other whitening products (like white strips) would not whiten evenly.

I went out on a limb and ordered this kit. At the time it was only $50 on Amazon. It came packaged as reported. I took my teeth impressions, the process was pretty easy, and sent them off to the lab in the pre-paid envelope. Then I crossed my fingers. I had every confidence that the initial package would arrive since it had the backing of Amazon, but I was a little dubious sending my impressions off to some random lab that's not affiliated with Amazon. I had decided just to wait until I got my customs trays to start using the whitening gel, rather than mess with the boil and bite trays.

Well, it was over a month and I was beginning to lose hope that my teeth trays would ever come, when I got an email that my trays were on their way! I had no idea when I ordered this kit how long the trays would take, and I don't think a month or two is an unreasonable amount of time to wait... so that's why I'm writing this review, to let customers know that they should be prepared to wait several weeks for the trays to arrive. But they do arrive! And I'm very happy with the result. The fit is precise and snug.

As for the 22% gel... I've been using it for about three weeks now, roughly 20 minutes to 30 minutes a day. It appears to have made my teeth brighter... not sure if it's made them all that much whiter. I'm a big coffee and tea drinker, so this gel is up against a lot of persistent staining. Looking up close in the mirror, I still see the yellow cast of my teeth stains, but the enamel underneath appears brighter. I'm probably going to try the 35% gel after I'm done with the gels that came with this kit.

But that's okay, because I have custom trays, now, and even if the gel they came with isn't sufficient, the trays (which, as I understand, would have cost a few hundred dollars from a dentist) are worth the price of the kit. Now that I have them I can order any gels I want from Amazon.

title: Myconos Long Lasting Multi BB Cushion 💧
text:
This is my first BB Cushion Compact.
I've had great experiences with Myconos products n the past so decided to try this out to for that full - Bang effect.

I currently own the following Myconos brand products:
- Gel cleanser
- Whitening & Brightening Essence/ Serum
- Night Repair Whitening Cream
- Deep Sea Whitening Mask
- (This) Myconos Magic BB Moist Air Cushion Compact.

* I will also add, I use these in conjunction/ in order :)

My Skin Type:
I have oily skin with acne spots occassionally.
My skin doesn't react well to extra moisturizing products like most bb cream for instance, they make me break out.

But, I decided to purchase this because I've read from other reviewers with oily skin that it didn't cause a hindrance for them- using this.
Sooo glad I did!

My First Impression/ Thoughts/ and Views:

- The design is pretty, unique & the holographic logo is quite attractive.
- Smells very fancy. Almost reminds me of Chanel.
- This goes smoothly.
- It is build able for me without looking too "cakey"
- Did not clog my pores. I was rest assured whenever I wore this, there wouldn't be a giant pimple at the end of the day on my forehead.
- The way the cushion is placed inside the compact is very sanitary, since there are layers to open to get to the bb cushion cream inside.
- Apparently this has "whitening properties" too
- I am in love with the fact this has a whopping 50spf! (Sun damage prevention is important to me)
- Anti-aging properties (Not too strong though I'm sure since other anti-aging products I've tried has broken me out before. I'm 22.)
- One of the best part of this product in my opinion is how you get an extra "refill of BB/CC foundation" Not even some other popular brands or Sephora items do that. So you're getting a considerable amount for the price.

Cons:

Aside from all the benefits, the only issue I've come across is sometimes (since I have oily skin) within a few hours,
if I don't pat down with a powder of some sort then my face gets sticky.
This is certainly an ideal product for those with "dry skin" type.

Conclusion:

In the end, the pros and benefits I got from using this bb cushion pact, definitely overcomes the negatives.
I love this bb cushion pact and will continue to keep using it. '

Since this is my first time using one and it's working so great, it'll possibly be my last time since there's another refill so this will last me a long time in a long run.

I ordered this because I'm reducing plastics in my household and my old loofah was one of those fluffy plastic ones. So I figured I'd go natural. Basically, I got the wrong kind of loofah, at least for my needs. It's great for when I wash my feet and armpits (I use a natural zinc based deodorant so it's kind of difficult to wash off with the fluffy plastic loofah) but it's way too rough for the rest of my body.
I soaked it as instructed, because it does come flat as a board and dry as can be, but I have to soak it before every shower or it's intolerable-that's a pain. I'm going to use them all, of course, but I already have my next style of natural loofah picked out.
I also noticed that I have to use a lot of soap, way more than normal. It has softened a bit with use, but you can still cut glass with the edges.
If you need extreme full body exfoliation, this is the product for you. My sensitive skin is just not having it. The seller was very clear in their description so it's my own mistake, and I don't blame them at all. It's a good product but I deducted a star because I absolutely hate it, for me. I can totally imagine this is right for someone else.

title: Jet Clean is a gimmick; any Norelco model is just as good
text:
If you don't own a Norelco triple-head razor, stop reading now and just buy one -- any one. Or if you own an ancient Norelco double-header, or a triple-header before the Lift'n'Cut heads, sure, get a new one. But if, like me, you have an old model, do your utmost to replace its parts and you'll be just as happy. (I replaced heads and two solder-tab NiCd's.) Here's why (echoing other reviewers' sentiments):
(i) This particular model is no faster than my old one, its "Speed XL" moniker notwithstanding. Maybe that's because of the new blade size/design, or maybe the old motor turns faster. (Seemingly, old AC and NiCd models spin faster than old NiMH models; YMMV.)
(ii) This model is no more adjustable (N/M/S) for closeness of shave than my old adjustable model (1-10). The heads do indeed rock more than the old spring suspension, but I still must stretch my skin with the other hand to get a close shave over the bumps.
(iii) The cleaning system leaves stubble-grit on the rubber bits. Also mine required repairs after 5 months, because the washer mechanism got stuck. (It has a 2-year warranty (yay!), alas they insisted on shipping the razor back, too (aargh!).) Norelco's attempt to "Gillette up a revenue stream" with consumables, i.e. cleanser fluid, is a little transparent.
(iv) The cleaning system leaves you with a damp razor, even if you shake it and let it stand for an entire day -- it's the shaving equivalent of a wet willie in the morning. Worse, the small quantity of liquid remaining is just enough to create a jumpy slide across the face -- not as even as completely dry, nor as smooth as a lubricated wet shave.

On the plus side, the battery life on this razor is excellent, and longer than old Norelcos. If you live out of a suitacase, you won't have to pack the cord. Which is good, because the charger circuit has been pulled out of the razor body and into a wall wart.

The razor rates 4 stars (not 5 because they have made better razors before, and hopefully will hence). The cleaning system gets 1 star. So don't get a CC model, but definitely do buy a Norelco razor. If you switch from blade or foil electric, please do as the manual says: give it two weeks of rotary use before judging the closeness of the shave. But especially if it's your first razor, grasshopper, you will be hooked for life!

title: Salon eyebrow-tinting is now a thing of the past
text:
I have brown hair but was born with naturally light and sparse eyebrows. I used to spend obscene amounts of money getting my brows done for up to $20 at the salon (oftentimes they didn't get it as dark as I wanted), but since purchasing this product I haven't been back! Since I know how I like my brows better than any esthetician would, I apply the dye as I would fill in my brows with a pencil or eyeshadow. I let the dye sit for about 2-3 minutes, then wipe it off with a rag (caution: the dye DOES stain rags!). The dye is inevitably on my skin for a day or 2, but since I fill in only where I'd actually put makeup, it's like I have makeup on and they actually look fuller (just use caution when applying). The box comes with at least 20 or so capsules of dye (which are the hardest to open without getting powder in my sink), so that means I can literally dye my brows 20 different times. The dye lasts about 2 weeks at a time. Overall, if you have lightly-colored eyebrows and want them to be darker, I highly recommend this. It's saved me time, money, and hassle!

I attached 2 photos to this review: Picture #1 is my natural brows, before dying, and picture #2 is shortly after dying, with my brows brushed upwards with some drugstore brow gel. The first is taken with my iPhone and 2nd picture with my Canon DSLR, but the sparsity of my natural eyebrows should definitely be apparent in the first photo despite the lower-quality.

title: My new favorite product!
text:
Update - May 19 2015:
Well here we are, one month later, and I just finished my first tube. I have been rotating between three flavors, mint, cherry, and vanilla, but I always carry one with me. These things last! They are much better than any generic I have tried, and my lips aren't a chapped, uncomfortable mess. I am very happy I tried these and recommend them highly. A quick word on the flavors I have tried. I like the mint when I am on the go. It has a light, natural flavor that is strong enough to notice, but not so strong that it is overwhelming. The balm is uncolored, so there is no concern about it looking like lip gloss or lipstick. I like the cherry as a change of pace, but it is tinted a light shade of pink, and while I don't notice the color on my own lips (I have a medium skin tone), I would test it before wearing it in public if color is a concern. The vanilla, well... different people have different tastes. I won't say it is bad, but I like the other two flavors much more. My issue with the vanilla is that the cocoa butter in the balm is very noticeable in scent and flavor, and when I apply it, my mind is immediately taken to thinking "sun block, or sunscreen." The fragrance and flavor remind me more of a skin lotion than something I would reach for to put on my lips. Some people may like that, but I prefer something else. That, however, is the only negative I found. The product itself is outstanding, it does exactly what one wants it to do, and saves the user money as compared to using other similar products. If you are debating on this one, try it. I don't think you will be disappointed.

title: Shifts beard length setting without warning
text:
My T980 does almost everything perfectly: it holds a charge for weeks; its vacuum reduces the number of trimmed hairs around the sink by about 70%; it feels wonderful and it works quickly.

However, my T980 does NOT stay at the level I set it at. If I don't firmly grip the length setting wheel it will jump from, say, a 5 to a 3 -- as it did this morning -- embarrassing me either by giving me a patchy trim or by forcing me to shorten my beard length.

This problem doesn't seem to be a result of the way I'm, say, holding the trimmer -- I used the [[ASIN:B0001HYL0M T765]] for four years without having this problem -- but rather a flaw in the trimmer itself. From these reviews, it seems like only a few of the T980s have this problem; still, you might want to try the [[ASIN:B000FED5D0 T780]], which doesn't seem to have this problem -- I wish I had.

Update 3/12/08: Make me look like a fool once, shame on me; make me look like a fool twice, shame on you.

I've used this trimmer about 12 times since writing this review, and by a combination of duct tape, a pinch grip, and a good deal of vigilance I had been able to avoid too many embarrassing shifts in beard length.

...until this morning, when it shifted silently from a 5 (Late Winter Academic Beard) to 3 (Peach Fuzz) in mid-shave. Two options: shave my entire beard to a 3, which is inappropriate for my face type, or look deranged because half of my face is at 5 and half is at 3.

I threw my T980 in the garbage ten minutes ago.

title: Dyed perfectly, so in love 💜
text:
Okay... I just got this hair and just dyed it and cannot tell you how it sheds (because it didn’t at all during the whole dyeing and styling process) how it tangles (also didn’t tangle at all that whole time) or how long it will last, but if you want to hear how silky soft and gorgeous and beautiful it looks when it’s dyed then keep reading 😋

I used just ONE box of Revlon Color silk #60 to dye a 10” frontal, 12” bundle and 14” bundle of this hair. It was my first time ever dyeing bundles, but I’m thrilled with how they turned out. Literally PERFECT. Everyone on youtube suggested this dye for 613 hair and you just can’t beat the price. I never really wash my bundles (gross I know, but I like only wear them once or twice) so I can’t say how long the dye lasts. What I did was cowash the hair with the conditioner in the box first and then first put the dye on the roots of the frontal. It stained the lace underneath in weird polka
for patterns, but you can see it so it doesn’t matter. Again, I did *not* know what I was doing lol. Then I put half the dye on the bundles while they were still wrapped and worked it through with my hands, without combing it through. Then I went back to the frontal and combed all the dye through evenly after giving the first round of dye to sit while I was working on the bundles. Once that was all even I went back to the bundles, unrolled them, put the remaining half of the bottle on them, worked it through with my hands on both and then combed it through each strand. I rinsed the frontal out first, in the sink with the highest water pressure and only rinsed for about three minutes. Then rinsed each bundle for three minutes and then went back and rinsed all the dye out of each one. By doing everything in batches and unevenly it left behind a bunch of different colors and made it look so natural. If you let it sit longer than 30 minutes it will start to turn a way different color than blonde haha so beware. You can see the roots on the frontal look much darker because they had dye on them for the longest period of time, but even though that was an accident I think it looks even better haha. And when you put the dye on be sure to use vertical stripes, not horizontal ones! I am in love with the color and this is probably the only dye I will ever use for 613 hair.

I let it air dry for about 30 minutes, which if I’m honest was not enough, but I’m so impatient lol. They were mostly dry except for at the very top. I did not blow dry them (so important). I just used a flat iron to curl small strands one by one (whole styling took one hour 🤦‍♀️). And even though they were a bit damp they still came out perfectly and they HOLD a curl like none other. Idk how it would be if you used a curling iron, but curling with a flat iron always gives the best results. They smell so good from the conditioner even though I just conditioned and then dyed and then didn’t put anything else on them. And they are so silky like Disney princess hair. I don’t plan on wearing these for a few months, but I love them so much.

PS I took those pictures outside in the sunlight so you can really see the true shade!

title: Good, with one Caveat
text:
I really like this shaver and I use it a lot. I write a lot of reviews on Amazon that are for fun only and not serious, but believe me, I am being serious here.

This shaver has lots of good features, and it definitely does pay for itself. I'm a guy who just likes having a crew cut, and this shaver is perfect for that. Why go to the store and pay $15 to have some stranger cut your hair (and have to waste your time waiting until they can get to you) when you can just buy this baby and do it yourself? Or better yet, have your significant other help you out and do it for you. It has already paid for itself several times over. (I like Setting 2, myself.)

Also very useful is the nose hair trimmer. This is not something that guys like to talk about very often but it happens to the best of us and there's no shame in trimming that unsightly growth out. This one is very useful. You just clip it in, turn it on, and jam that sucker up your nostril. Again, VERY useful.

The rest of the attachments were okay but not necessary, in my opinion.

So why 4 stars? Because of an accident that I had once with this thing, a manufacturer problem. I had started shaving my head and the power went out. Apparently it wasn't fully charged. So I was left with stripes of bald patches running down my hair, and it looked extremely bad.

I recharged it overnight, but had to go to work the next morning and didn't have time to finish the job before I left. So I had to go to work with my hair looking all nappy like I had been suffering from radiation fallout sickness or something. I had to hole up in my office all day, so I would not be seen.

This disaster could have been easily averted had the power supply on this thing been set up so that you can use the device while it is plugged in. Only it doesn't work that way. It is not set up to operate off of a power supply. It is only set up to operate off of its charge. So when it is plugged in, it is only charging the battery. If the battery is dead, then it won't turn on and you can't use it even when it is plugged in!

Whoever heard of such a crazy arrangement? This is totally unlike the other Norelco shaver (the 3-disc beard shaver). It makes me want to give it 1 star, but that would be unfair.

So basically here is my advice: Make sure that this thing is well-charged before you put it to your head. Otherwise, you may be sorry! Take it from somebody who has been there.

text:
Like another reviewer, this was not an item I would have selected myself. I received it as a gift from a friend and was hesitant to use it out of fear that it would have an overpowering floral smell due to the lavender. However, the bar ended up being a pleasant surprise, and I will likely buy it again.

Since I don't like too many bubbles in my bath and, more importantly, like stretching my Lush products as much as possible due to the cost, I cut the bar into fourths. I found it to be a lot harder to cut than most Lush products, so if you're going to cut it, use a really strong knife and be ready for it to blow apart a bit as you slice through. (It's pretty crumbly.)

What I like about this bar is that, even though it's not very bubbly -- even as someone who cuts bars, I usually get more from others than this one -- it leaves a wonderful silky feeling on your body. I love that, even in the water, I can feel it on my legs, and not in an annoying greasy way at all. It's so relaxing! I usually put cocoa butter on my legs after shaving, and I don't need to do anything after using this bar. It has some sort of wonderful lotion quality about it that I adore. More than the scent or bubbles, that is the reason I will purchase it for myself in the future.

The only objection I have is that it seems to melt a bit more than other bubble bars. I've kept it in a sealed container in a cool area, but it just doesn't keep well. If you're going to cut it, be sure to use the other pieces within a couple weeks at the most. And, like all bubble bars, don't get it wet unless you're going to use it right away, because even the tiniest bit of moisture gets it going.

text:
I have been using beard products for a while now, may it be growth formulas or simple oils, I must say that caring for my beard has really made it look much better than before. As far as beard shampoo goes, I never really knew about this. I would simply use ordinary hair shampoo or even soap to wash my beard every time that I’d shower, but since I stumbled upon this, I thought to give it a try. Now for starters, this bottle is actually of a pretty decent size. It will definitely last a while if used carefully. Now the shampoo itself does its job. I have used for about 2-3 days now, and I can’t say that I have any complaints. I would give it 5 stars but there are 1-2 issues that weren’t all too convincing for me.

The smell of the product is “Bold Forest”. Now I don’t really know what that really means, but the smell doesn’t really convince me tooooo much. Sure, it’s something I can get used to, but compared to the amazing smell I receive from my beard oils, I was surely expecting for this smell to match it too. But that’s not a major issue I suppose, as long as your beard is A-OK! Another thing that wasn’t quite convincing was that you have to kinda be careful while applying the shampoo on your palm. Although the hole is small, a lot might come out so you got to be steady with that. Also, the shampoo isn’t the same as hair shampoo, it’s actually a bit gooey, which caught me by surprise, but then again, I didn’t really know what to expect when buying “beard shampoo”. Other than that, my beard these past few days has felt a bit softer and “fresher”, if I may. As far as dandruff and all goes, I’m sure that a beard shampoo is essential if you really want to grow your beard. I don’t have a huge beard myself, it’s actually a bit small. But everyone has to start somewhere, right? I use this product while showering (twice a day), and right after I shower, I towel-dry my beard and apply my beard oil (incase you were wondering). All in all, I definitely recommend this beard shampoo!

The design flaw is in the rotation from magnified to unmagnified. You can rotate the mirror any direction and number of times you want. So, unless you are disciplined enough to only rotate the mirror 90 degrees one way and then back the opposite direction, you are effectively twisting the wires. We all know that if you twist wires enough they become faulty. Had the design included a stop on the rotation so that you could only rotate it one way and then back the other, it would reduce the chances of the wires twisting too much. My wife needed a new lava stone to scrub some of the dirt and dead skin off the heel of her foot. We have another stone that is beginning to wear out, so this is meant to serve as a replacement. Here are her thoughts:

• Size/Texture: This one is larger than our other stone, but still fits easily in the palm of the hand. Texture is as you would expect, with good scrape-ability not too sharp that it would hurt the foot.

• Dirt Removal: The before and after pictures above were taken after three uses. In general, we are happy with the stone’s ability to remove dirt from the bottom of the foot.

• Dead Skin Removal: By contrast, we were somewhat disappointed with the stone’s ability to fully remove the dead skin. As you can see from the photo, some of the dead skin is gone but the bottom of her foot is still a little rough.

In summary, this is a decent value given the low price point. We’ll knock off a star due to the lack of dead skin removal, but I would say that we are generally satisfied with its effectiveness, and therefore, we give this a solid four stars and recommend this to anyone who needs an extra stone for the shower.

I had been using Neutrogena T Gel Shampoo which helped but was rather harsh and drying. While I was on Amazon searching for more Wen products I found the Wen Tea Tree Cleansing Conditioner. I am coming to the bottom of my fourth 16 ounce bottle and just saw a one gallon size advertised on Amazon. In spite of the expense I think I may just buy the gallon as my hair has never been this silky smooth and easy to style even though I now have a longer, shoulder length bob haircut.
I especially like the fact that I can use the Wen as a leave in conditioner if I want to simply by doing a second wash and partial rinse out at the end of my luxurious Wen Tea Tree shower. Unlike other leave in conditioners I have used in the past, Wen does not leave the same heavy residue that interferes with my final styling product. It only makes my styling product work better and my blow dry session no longer turns into a scorched earth session! Wen also smell marvelous due to the Tea Tree Oil. The regular Wen Cleansing Conditioner also has a nice light scent. I only wish Wen was easier to find and purchase. title: Very strong scent at first, but it disappears very quickly.
text:
I really loved the idea of this Boiess Baby Cologne "Les Enfants" in White Blossom. Not because I think it is a good idea for a baby, because boy, is it not. I actually thought it would be perfect for myself since I don't like loud fragrances. The description of the scent profile really enticed me, as I love all of the notes. I was able to try both the Lavanda and the White Blossom scents.
Both of the "Cologne" sprays smell identical to me. I can't say that I can tell them apart at all. They both have a very strong earthy, herbal, slightly floral scent that is heavily ladened with alcohol upon spraying. It stays very strong for several minutes, but then starts to dry down.
Sadly, once it dries down, the scent pretty much dissipates. If I don't spray it heavily at first, which is too much for my asthma to handle, much less any baby, the scent just goes away completely. I must spray it on me again. If I spray it on a few times over an hour or so, I can smell the ever so slightest hint of it on my clothing later, if I put my nose right on it. That is a lot of spraying for very little payoff.
I know this is meant for kids mostly, but I would think the scent would and should last longer. Sure, my grandsons will like using it, maybe or not, as it is quite strong at first. But, I think it would just be more for the fun of it and very short lived. This is also very expensive "Cologne" to not be able to smell it after 30 minutes, and right at $28 is too expensive for me to buy just for the fun of it.  
For others this "Baby Cologne" may be something wonderful or maybe they can smell it more than I can. As I said, I really love the idea of a light fragrance, but not for babies. I do wish the scent stuck around more for me.

title: It was exactly what I expected.
text: I purchased this to repair a model G Black limited edition clipper, which is basically a GTX. The GTO uses a 2 wire cord (without a ground) and we order those direct from Andis along with all of the other Andis products we sell or use to repair and sharpen equipment. They claim the 3 wire cord is only for Canada (and would not supply them to us), but many barbers in SoCal have the GTX and they need to be repaired no matter where it was intended to be sold. Some people think the heavier cord helps the performance of the clipper, but they would be wrong. At 10-12 watts, the amperage draw is far less than what a small wire is capable of handling. I did not measure the gauge of the wire in this cord to see how it compares to the GTO cords, but the only benefit of a heavier wire is that it will take longer for fatigue to cause the wire to break at the clipper. While the cost of this cord is more than buying it wholesale, Amazon was a convenient and fast way to get my hands on this item.

text:
You do NOT want this brand of dye if you make drastic changes to your color frequently [if you want to go from pink to green, for example] because it is extremely difficult to strip and you will damage your hair trying to remove it. This brand is also difficult to dye over, when I tried red for a month it had a VERY pink undertone even after fading and bleaching, other people - specifically Atomic Pink users report difficulty getting even black to go over their color without it having a purple undertone.

That being said, if you actually WANT vibrantly colored hair and don't want to recolor every two weeks this is the brand for you. I have run with atomic pink for 3+ years and just recently decided to fade in preparation for another color, and now, nearly six months after my last re-dye it's just barely starting to get patchy in places and fade at the tips. For that alone I will give this product 5 stars.

title: Wow, super-heavy and solid!  This extra "arm" really works!
text:
I admit that I felt silly buying this...but I HATE to blow-dry my hair because I have very thick, wavy, and frizz-prone hair. So usually when I blow-dry it, I can't use the brush properly like a hairdresser would to really work the frizz out and dry it properly and it ends up look dry and poofy until the next day when it settles down. I typically let my hair just wet-dry and then style with some cream and a curling iron to smooth my ends. But when I saw this, I just had to try it despite having a small bathroom and thinking "do you really want that thing hanging on you wall?" The answer is..."Not really, but I really want a free hand to dry my hair."

So I bought it. Although I was still really unsure about the safety of sectioning this thing to my wall. I imagined it crashing down and smashing my toiletries, injuring the cat, or crashing onto someone's head. I wondered why I decided to buy it. But then I received it in the mail, opened it, and was really surprised at how incredibly heavy and solid this thing is. Everytime I buy a product that is supposed to "suction" and be strong....it isn't. Well, this one is REALLY strong.

I first tested it by suctioning it to the wall (not the mirror as shown in the ad) and left it there for about 2 days just to see if there was any sliding, slipping, or loosening. I pulled HARD on it various ways to try to get it to fall down. This thing is 100% solid and the suction is super-strong. If it stuck to my painted wall, this would never come off a mirror! Then after I inspected it a good bit, bent the arm around, tried out the bungee, and figured out which way the holder that the blow-dryer goes in is supposed to go....I placed my hair dryer in it. I had a hard time, at first getting my dryer to fit because I still had the holder upside down. If the large bolt is pressing against the back of your dryer, it's upside down and it won't seat properly and the bungee will be super-hard to clip (or not at all). So I was like "great this thing doesn't fit my dryer". But you have to twist and move it around to figure out which way yours fits and then it's all pretty much smooth sailing from there.

The "arm" that bends is also really hard to bend and very solid and thick. Merely bumping it (which I did several times), walking into it, or yanking your dryer around doesn't make this flop around. It requires two hands to bend and stays firmly in whatever position you place it for drying. Keep in mind this means that other than minor adjustments, if you need to totally change the dryer position while drying...you will need to take a second to move the arm and reposition it a bit, which is not a one-handed job. I really like that about this. When I finally tried using it after my shower (after days of leaving it hang up to ensure it doesn't fall, playing around with it, and letting my family get used to it being in their way because of our small bathroom) I was delighted that when I moved the dryer lower to blow straight at me....it stayed firmly in place, even after accidentally slapping it with my hairbrush and hands several times. I moved it into a "downward" blowing position about halfway through to get the back and was able to not only use a brush and my hands like a normal person, but I noted that I was able to get my hair dry in half the normal time (I assume because of extra brushes and hands). My hair even looked less frizzy and more like what it should look like after I go to the salon! My significant other came home and laughed when he saw me awkwardly using it and trying to position it right....but he thinks it's cool, too.

It made my life much easier and really DOES function like a permanent fixture if you want it to. I plan to leave mine up all of the time for ease of use rather than redoing the suction and placement each time. It's easy to just take the arm and push it up really high when you're done, take the dryer out of it, and it's out of the way of anyone walking through, opening cabinets, etc until next time you want to use it.

This is a pretty innovative product and I don't feel like I wasted money on it because it has made a loathsome part of my beauty routine easier...even if it did make my bathroom just slightly uglier :-)

In all seriousness, if you have space or really hate trying to use a brush and properly dry your hair, this is worth it. If I had more storage nearby, I'd probably take it down in between uses because it really is easy to suction and adjust once you understand what goes where and how it works. I had fun trying this out and using it on my hair and plan to keep on using it in the future. It's an odd device, for sure...but doesn't hesitate if you're worried it will be "cheap" or flimsy. This thing could be a deadly weapon, it's so heavy and clearly intended to stay in place. If that's what you need in a dryer holder, absolutely buy this. I don't regret my purchase and I doubt you will, either. I hope you found my review to contain useful information and I am happy to answer any questions you may have. Thanks for reading and happy styling!!

*It was really hard to take clear photos once hung because it's large and I choose to really snake it around, but hopefully you can get an idea of size and set up from them*

title: Fantastic product for oily skin.
text:
This product isn't sold in the US unfortunately, so it may take a little bit longer to ship. That said, it's definitely worth the wait. I have extremely oily skin, and this does a very good job at lessening it. When I don't use this, I have to use multiple oil-blotting sheets throughout the day. My usual routine is to use a cleanser that helps with the oil - something with salicylic acid, or lately Dermologica's Dermal Clay Cleanser, then use some witch hazel as an astringent/toner. After that I use a little bit of oil-free moisturizer, then once that's try, I put this under base on. I noticed immediately that it dries very fast. It doesn't make your skin dry, but I don't have to wait forever for it to soak in before I put on my makeup - it helps the moisturizer soak in faster too. My pores looked much smaller, and my skin felt very smooth. Like other reviewers have said, it made a very nice canvas for the makeup.
You may find yourself surprised at the size when you receive it - the canister is much smaller than you might expect, and it's metal. Depending on how much you use, you might want to go ahead and buy two, just because of how long it will take you to receive your next one. Another word of warning - you'll need a lot less than you think. When you press on the pump, you really only need to tap it; it will put out a bunch of mousse very quickly, and it's easy to get more than you need.
All in all, it's a really fantastic product, and despite the price tag it's really worth it.

title: Something that finally works.
text:
I'm a 23 year old female that has battled acne for 10 years. It's not just mild acne- it's cystic, life-damaging, skin-destroying acne. I get it mostly on my outer cheeks and chin. I've tried exfoliants, cleansers, toners, masques. I've done home remedies. Egg whites, oatmeal and honey, hydrogen peroxide, oil cleansing. Things will start to work, or work for a small time, and then my face will be back to it's oily, cystic self.

Recently I've been using an Aveeno daily exfoliator with an Aveeno moisturizer. It wasn't really doing the trick. I thought, perhaps I need to use toner. Since Aveeno is all natural, I decided to stick with that theme.

I *LOVE* this product. I will take off my makeup at night, spritz my face with toner, then apply moisturizer. After the first day I noticed my skin was less greasy/oily. It just felt better. I started to get concerned when I began getting small white pimples appearing, but friends told me that was my face getting rid of the junk. I was just thankful they weren't huge cysts! A week later, my skin is almost completely clear. I only have one active pimple on my face that is in the process of healing. I hope that it stays this way!

Also I must say that the smell is divine! My boyfriend even likes it. I wish the bottle would never run out, but I know that when it does, I'm buying another.

title: DMSO’s super efficient through-the-skin delivery means that it has to be extremely pure to be safe
text:
DMSO has a low toxicity rating and may very well be a “miracle” pain reliever and have many other beneficial uses, but its biggest plus is also its biggest minus—it quickly and super-effectively delivers substances through the skin and into the bloodstream, and magnifies or “potentiates” their effects. This can be beneficial in some situations, but potentially very harmful in others, and that’s likely why the research on DMSO is so contradictory.

DMSO’s super efficient through-the-skin delivery means that it has to be extremely pure to be safe. Any impurities or toxins present will be carried directly into the bloodstream. In addition, substances already on the skin when DMSO is applied, such as body lotions, will be carried into the blood.

More at virginiahopkinstestkits.com/dmsorisks. html

title: Twice As Much of A Waste As One Bottle!
text:
The current version of Tsar is a pitiful, inert, dullard of a fragrance that smells markedly like Old Spice. No need for anyone save masochists to stockpile!

Per other reviewers considering vintage bottles, this fragrance used to be an interesting powerhouse. Unfortunately, as IFRA (regulatory agency) restrictions on perfume content and overall manufacturing costs have increased, many manufacturers have simply stopped trying to inventively reformulate older fragrances, so what the buyer ends up with is the modern version of Tsar: a weak not especially complex or interesting scent with minimal projection and average longevity. When applied, I get a burst of alcohol and green, and then in about 10 minutes, some hint of pine, amber, and florals (carnation, geranium, lily of the valley maybe?). I smell no leather, no oak moss, no vetiver, no tonka beans, and only the slightest hint of patchouli. This becomes a skin scent really quickly, i.e. no projection, but it does last for about 6-8 hrs as a skin scent. This long duration is really the only major advantage Tsar has over Old Spice, which sells for half the price and smells oddly similar!

On Fragrantica.com, there are like 27 different scent ingredients listed for Tsar (or at least claimed for Tsar by its manufacturer), which is simply absurd. VC&A are either having some fun with us, citing historical formulas that are 10 years put of date, or have succeeded in generating the blandest possible result from the most ornately Byzantine of recipes. In comparison, Terre D'Hermes, with a mere 8 ingredients cited on the same site, smells like it is several magnitudes of complexity higher, a symphony compared to Tsar's hummed nursery rhyme.

Frankly, I think most buyers should spend their dollars elsewhere. Many of the old vintage powerhouses have not been reformulated into the same decreptitude that Tsar has; Azzarro Pour Homme, Lapidus, Aramis, Havana, Tuscany, Yatagan: all still around, all smell great, though maybe not quite as good as they used to. Even Grey Flannel, which is currently much cheaper than Tsar, smells much better and still has some of its cojones attached. So if you want to see what the 80s (or earlier!) smelled like, you have a lot of options. Tsar certainly won't appeal to most young modern male fragrance buyers who love calone, seaweed, and apple. And if your tastes are for more refined "older" stuff, the dull ghostwater found in bottles of Tsar holds little appeal at the current price point. Get Azzarro PH or Lapidus for less money and have more fun!

On the plus side, Tsar is certainly workplace friendly, as no one will smell it on you unless you are giving them a piggyback ride or are lying on top of them, both of which circumstances are uncommon enough in the workplace so as to preclude their likelihood of occurrence.

Other exhibits in the realm of the Former Powerhouse Roll of Dishonor are worse than Tsar: the current Halston Z14, Ungaro III, and Paco Rabanne all have been even more neglected / manhandled into smelling weak / unpleasant/ or both. And even weak Tsar smells better than many modern fragrances, alas, but that's beyond the point. Bottom line: unless this falls in price to the level of Nausea Voyage, there are many better options for less money.

text: I had never even heard of SHASH prior to my seeing this razor here on Amazon. Like most, I had been looking at Parker, Merkur, Vikings Blade, Earnest James, etc. to replace my nine year-old Parker 96R razor. BTW, the Parker 96R is still working perfectly, and the only wear and tear can be seen on the black handle. I also made the change from a butterfly razor to the more classic three-piece razor. For some reason, I thought I would never buy any razor that wasn't a butterfly type. Then it slowly dawned on me that the three-piece style ain't rocket science to put together. And, sure enough, after receiving this SHASH Dean Collection razor, I have learned it's almost as easy as the butterfly style. Plus, you get a very tight and secure closure when you screw the head piece(s) & blade to the handle. I am using Wilkinson blades, and only because I like them - this razor, of course, can use any DE razor blade. In fact, this razor comes with a generous supply of 30 Astra blades which I will try at some point. All in all, I am very pleased and impressed with this SHASH razor and its craftsmanship. Hopefully it will last another nine years with no need for replacement like my old, trusty Parker 96R. (BTW, check out the difference in the underside of the two razors. Notice how the SHASH underside is an upward arc, whereas the Parker 96R and the majority of DE razors are a downward arc. I notice that the upward arc gently pulls up the skin and hair immediately prior to cutting with the blade, resulting in a more pronounced "sound" of cutting. Sounds crazy I know, but it's true. In any case, a BBS shave results.) The length of this razor is 4 3/8".

The new unit I received is not round like this picture. It is kidney shaped.
The old version I had to add a small amount of salt to the water.
The newer version has a slider switch for OFF, STEAM and IONIC STEAM.
I love, love, love the Caruso Steam for my hair.
I used 6-8 curlers for my whole head.
Literally seconds to put each in and about the time I get them all in it is time to take them out. Just like my old Caruso Steam unit (without the salt).
My curls last three days minimum.
I DO NOT use hair products on my hair ever.
Curls are soft and natural feeling.
Caruso Steamer does not damage hair. Stopped perms many years ago after finding this steamer. This amazing steamer adds shine to my curls. I can run my fingers through my hair as much as I want.
There is never those bent ends of hair, curls just fall, I shake my head, move a curl or two with my fingers and I am out the door.
I have missed this little time saver and am continually complimented on my hair and how much younger I look.
I hope this helps someone, lets me know how you use your Caruso Steamer
